name: codemap-graph
description: Local-first code graph for chat: a privacy-audited @codegraph chat participant, interactive graph viewer, multi-language indexing, and slash commands for path/impact/report. Works with GitHub Copilot Chat.

chatParticipants.name: codegraph
chatParticipants.description: Ask CodeGraph to understand, fix, test, or review this workspace using a local code graph. Try /help for slash commands.

commands.name: path
commands.description: Find the shortest import path between two files (local, no model call)

commands.name: impact
commands.description: List files that transitively depend on a given file (local)

commands.name: report
commands.description: Generate a full local graph report (god nodes, communities, surprises)

commands.name: savings
commands.description: Token-savings analysis: how many tokens CodeGraph saved vs. a naive baseline

commands.name: models
commands.description: Benchmark table of available models (capability, cost, speed, context) and your current pick

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Show the last 10 model calls and bytes sent

commands.name: privacy
commands.description: Open the Privacy Center to switch modes

commands.name: wipe
commands.description: Wipe the local index and/or audit log

languageModelTools.name: codegraph_runInTerminal
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a shell command in the workspace root and return its combined stdout/stderr and exit code. Use this to build, run tests, start the app, run git, or any command-line task. The user is asked to confirm before the command runs unless they enabled auto-approval.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Let CodeGraph run shell commands (with confirmation)

command.description: The exact shell command to run.

explanation.description: One sentence on why this command is being run, shown to the user.

cwd.description: Optional working directory relative to the workspace root.

languageModelTools.name: codegraph_readFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the contents of a file in the workspace, optionally limited to a line range. Read-only; returns numbered lines.

path.description: File path relative to the workspace root.

languageModelTools.name: codegraph_writeFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a new file or overwrite an existing one with the given full content. The user is asked to confirm unless they enabled auto-approval of edits.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Let CodeGraph create or overwrite files (with confirmation)

path.description: File path relative to the workspace root.

content.description: The full new content of the file.

languageModelTools.name: codegraph_replaceInFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Replace an exact text snippet in an existing file. By default replaces the first occurrence; set all=true to replace every occurrence. Fails if the find text is not present. The user is asked to confirm unless they enabled auto-approval of edits.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Let CodeGraph apply targeted edits to files (with confirmation)

path.description: File path relative to the workspace root.

replace.description: The text to replace it with.

all.description: Replace all occurrences instead of just the first.

languageModelTools.name: codegraph_listDirectory
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the files and subfolders of a directory in the workspace. Read-only.

path.description: Directory path relative to the workspace root. Defaults to the root.

languageModelTools.name: codegraph_findFiles
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find files in the workspace by glob pattern (e.g. src/**/*.ts). Read-only; excludes node_modules, dist, build, and .git.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Let CodeGraph search for files by name

glob.description: Glob pattern to match, relative to the workspace root.

languageModelTools.name: codegraph_impact
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Using the local code graph, list every file that transitively imports the given file (its reverse-dependency / blast radius). Use before changing a widely-used file.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Let CodeGraph compute a file's impact set

file.description: File path (full or partial) to analyze.

languageModelTools.name: codegraph_dependencyPath
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Using the local code graph, find the shortest import path between two files. Useful for understanding how two parts of the codebase are connected.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Let CodeGraph trace import paths between files

languageModelTools.name: codegraph_godNodes
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Using the local code graph, list the most-connected files (degree centrality) — the architectural hubs of the codebase.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Let CodeGraph list the most-connected files

limit.description: How many hub files to return (default 15).

codegraph.privacyMode.description: Controls whether CodeGraph sends prompts to the language model. 'standard' sends prompts and logs each send to the audit log. 'preview-before-send' asks for confirmation each time. 'local-only' blocks all model calls — the extension only indexes and visualizes locally.

codegraph.enableAgentTools.description: Allow the @codegraph chat agent to use tools — running terminal commands, reading/writing files, and querying the code graph — to actually carry out requests. Turn off to make @codegraph a read-only responder that only explains and suggests.

codegraph.includeExternalTools.description: Also expose tools registered by other extensions (e.g. Copilot's built-in tools) to the @codegraph agent, so it is not capability-limited compared with the built-in agent. Disable to restrict @codegraph to its own CodeGraph tools only.

codegraph.maxTools.description: Maximum number of tools to send to the model per request. Language models reject requests with more than 128 tools, so CodeGraph caps the list here (its own tools are always kept first). Lower this if a model you use has a smaller limit.

codegraph.maxAgentSteps.description: Maximum number of model round-trips the @codegraph agent may take in a single turn before it stops and offers a Continue button. Higher values let it complete larger multi-file tasks (e.g. read several files then apply several edits) without interruption; lower values cap cost per turn.

codegraph.autoApproveCommands.description: Run terminal commands requested by the agent WITHOUT asking for confirmation. Off by default — every command shows an inline 'Continue/Cancel' prompt. Enable only if you trust the agent in this workspace.

codegraph.autoApproveEdits.description: Create, overwrite, and edit files requested by the agent WITHOUT asking for confirmation. Off by default — every file change shows an inline confirmation.

codegraph.suggestModel.description: Master switch for model-fit suggestions. On simple queries CodeGraph suggests a cheaper model to save tokens; on hard queries a stronger one. Difficulty is scored locally first. Turn off to disable all model suggestions/prompts.

codegraph.modelSwitchPrompt.description: When a better-fit model is found, show in-chat buttons in the reply asking whether to answer with it. Clicking one reroutes @codegraph's OWN answer to your choice (re-runs the query on the next turn; your global model picker is never changed) and remembers your preference. Turn off to get a non-interactive advisory banner instead.

codegraph.suggestModelUsesLLM.description: On genuinely borderline queries, spend one tiny call to the CHEAPEST available model (query text only, never your code context) to grade difficulty more accurately. Results are cached so repeat questions are free, and the call is skipped entirely in local-only privacy mode. Turn off to rely on the zero-cost local heuristic alone.

codegraph.semanticSearch.enabled.description: Opt-in semantic (meaning-based) retrieval on top of the lexical+graph ranking, powered by a LOCAL embedding server you run yourself (Ollama or compatible). Nothing is bundled and no code ever leaves your machine — the endpoint is restricted to localhost. After enabling, run 'CodeGraph: Build Semantic Index'.

codegraph.semanticSearch.endpoint.description: Base URL of the local embedding server (Ollama-compatible). Must be a loopback address (localhost/127.0.0.1) — remote endpoints are rejected by design.

codegraph.semanticSearch.model.description: Embedding model the local server should use (e.g. 'nomic-embed-text', 'mxbai-embed-large'). Pull it first: `ollama pull nomic-embed-text`.
